expected_findings.rationale: Whole milk powder and soya lecithin are listed in the same plain text as the rest of the ingredients, with no bold, capitals or other emphasis distinguishing them.

trap: Milk and soya are genuinely present in the ingredients list, which can fool a naive system into marking the allergen requirement satisfied merely because the words appear, rather than checking whether they are actually emphasised.
notes: Direct UK counterpart to the IN-003 trap, testing the emphasis mechanic instead of the separate Contains statement mechanic.
